sourcesIncorporated.Curated: measles 2025–2026 + historical pandemic anchors + BSL labs

sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.WHO Outbreak Toolkit: guidance/framework — not a case data feed
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.CDC Data Portal (2000+ datasets): catalog; specific Socrata endpoints added as needed
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.Global.health line lists: requires free API key / account for bulk export
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.IDDO: individual participant data — registration / data use agreements
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.GIDS: no stable public bulk API identified
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.Figshare / Harvard Dataverse COVID colle: research archives — not live outbreak feeds
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.HealthMap: web UI; no stable free bulk API for redistribution
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.Yale PopHIVE: dashboard + some GitHub parquet; primary value is interactive UI
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.Brown Pandemic Center / Outbreak Observa: narrative synthesis reports, not bulk case API
sourcesLinkedNotBulkAutomated.UCSD DIRE: projection models / dashboard, not open bulk outbreak events

notes: Provisional surveillance data. NNDSS and NORS counts are subject to revision. COVID post-PHE reporting is incomplete. HDX dataset unit is country-year disease outbreak (WHO DON derived). World Bank rows are context indicators, not outbreak events.
